<user_query>
In the codebase at /home/admin, investigate why a student with courses set up might display "尚未設定補習科目/堂數" (no tutoring subjects/sessions set) in student management (學生管理).

Specifically:
1. Find the student management page/component — likely StudentManagement.vue or similar
2. Find the logic that determines whether to show "尚未設定補習科目/堂數" 
3. Find how student subject/session info is fetched and displayed
4. Look at what conditions cause the "not yet set up" message to show
5. Check relevant backend API endpoints for student info / student classes

Return:
- Key files and line numbers for the "尚未設定補習科目/堂數" display condition
- The data fields used to determine if subjects/sessions are set
- The API endpoint(s) that supply student class/subject data
- Any filtering logic that might exclude valid courses (e.g., by campus, status, type)
</user_query>

Searching the codebase for the message string and student-management components.
